keyword: was there a rocket launch today
claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 Starlink satellites from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on Tuesday, April 14, 2026, at 5:33 a.m. EDT (0933 UTC).
A Falcon 9 lifted off from SLC-40 at Cape Canaveral carrying 29 Starlink satellites.
The Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral on April 14, 2026 marked the 1,000th Starlink satellite launched in 2026.
A separate Falcon 9 is scheduled to lift off from Vandenberg Space Force Base (SLC-4E) at 7:40 p.m. PT.
The separate Falcon 9 launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base is to deploy 25 more Starlink satellites.
The first-stage booster of the Falcon 9 launch from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on April 14, 2026 successfully landed on a droneship in the Atlantic Ocean.
